title: Efest Lush Q2 Battery Charger
description:
Description
This Kit Includes
Specifications
Efest Lush Q2 dual battery charger. Compatible with the following batteries:
10440, 14500, 14650, 16340, 16650, 17650, 17670, 18350, 18490, 18500, 18650, 20700, 22650, 26500, 26650
Lush Q2 Charger
AC Adapter
Operation Manual
Warranty Card
Simple No Button Design
Battery Life LED Indicator
Auto selects 1.0A or 2.0A charging.
Auto stops when batteries are fully charged.
Auto recharges when batteries drop below 4.05v.
Protections against Over-discharge, Over-voltage, Short Circuit and Reverse Polarity.
